_comment: Weekly snapshots of the OPEN CommitFest, used to compute week-over-week deltas. Only the MOST RECENT week is kept in full (needed to track the fate of a patch flagged a week ago); every earlier week is collapsed to {week, cf, created_n, closed_n, net}. Full history lives in references/archive/commitfest-2026.json (not read at runtime).

weeks_summary.net: in-window: 4 committed, 2 withdrawn; multiple new records (UUID cluster, reorder-buffer perf, ANALYZE sampling hook, new GUC/aggregate proposals)
5 created vs 27 closed in covered span -> net -22 (queue draining as In Progress began; commit tempo ~6x last week's 4)

weeks.note: Captured Monday ~03:40 CEST. /61/activity/ reachable via /61/?tag=34 -> Activity log link.
